data.name: Hotel Posada de Roger
data.address: Basilio Badillo 237, Zona Romántica, Emiliano Zapata, 48380 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
Set in downtown Puerto Vallarta, this laid-back hotel is a 10-minute walk from Los Muertos Beach and 1.6 km from the Malecón boardwalk.
Featuring traditional Mexican decor, the colorful rooms also have free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and en suite bathrooms. Some also include balconies, minifridges, and tea and coffeemakers.
Amenities include an outdoor pool with a sundeck, as well as a rooftop terrace and a communal kitchen.
